evidence: Backports #36230, which improves wallet descriptor comparison performance in `HasWalletDescriptor` and adds descriptor backward-compatibility tests.
rationale: Backports performance improvements to descriptor comparisons that previously recomputed canonical strings on every check. Commit 7fdb8584da notes 'canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison', resolving this by caching the canonical string and hashing it.
